lastCompletedStory.title: Absent / malformed / stale report falls safely to the failure nets with no false-pass; staleness guard on the primary path

nextStoryContext: US-006 adds two code changes: (1) loop.ts poll loop now applies a staleness+shape guard before breaking on readWorkerReport() -- a stale report (story!=advisoryStoryId) or malformed report (missing string discriminators) does NOT exit the poll, letting pane-died/timeout nets with CAM-44 backoff remain the terminal signal; (2) host.ts makeReadWorkerReport now applies the US-R2-001 shape guard pattern (!Array.isArray + typeof outcome === string + typeof story === string) before casting. 14 new tests added: 11 in test/supervisor/result.test.ts (US-006 absent/malformed/stale describe block) and 6 in test/supervisor/loop.test.ts (US-006 stale/absent/malformed loop-level describe block). Total tests: 1372 pass / 0 fail.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-006 only touches src/supervisor/loop.ts (poll guard), src/supervisor/host.ts (shape guard), and test files. No external library API was exercised.
